# Saturn

> Saturn is a zero-configuration AI service discovery system using mDNS/DNS-SD to automatically advertise and locate OpenAI-compatible AI services on a local network. Think Bonjour for printers, but for AI APIs. Install with `pip install saturn-ai`.

Saturn eliminates per-app API key management and subscription juggling. A household, university, or office sets up Saturn servers once, and every device on the network gets AI access automatically.

- All services expose OpenAI-compatible endpoints: `/v1/health`, `/v1/models`, `/v1/chat/completions`
- Services register as `_saturn._tcp.local.` with TXT records (priority, version, capabilities, models)
- Priority-based routing: lower number = higher preference (10 beats 50)
- Health monitoring polls `/v1/health` every 20 seconds with automatic failover
- Streaming uses SSE format: `data: {json}\n\n` terminated by `data: [DONE]\n\n`
- Python 3.10+, MIT license, available on PyPI as `saturn-ai`

## Core API

- [Python Package (saturn)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jperrello/Saturn/main/saturn/README.md): Core package docs covering `discover()`, `select_best_service()`, `SaturnService`, `SaturnDiscovery`, and `SaturnAdvertiser`
- [AI SDK Provider (TypeScript)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jperrello/Saturn/main/ai-sdk-provider-saturn/README.md): Vercel AI SDK provider for Node.js — `ai-sdk-provider-saturn` on npm


## Quickstart

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jperrello/Saturn/main/README.md): Installation, CLI commands, server setup, discovery usage, and integration examples
- [Client Examples](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jperrello/Saturn/main/clients/README.md): Reference implementations — simple chat, local proxy, file upload

## CLI Reference

```
saturn discover          # Find all Saturn services on network
saturn endpoint          # Get best service URL (for scripts)
saturn endpoint --json   # Machine-readable output
saturn run <name>        # Start a configured service (ollama, openrouter, deepinfra, orbeacon, fallback)
saturn stop <name>       # Stop a running service
saturn config list       # List all service configurations
saturn config new        # Create custom service interactively
saturn ollama            # Shortcut: run Ollama service
saturn openrouter        # Shortcut: run OpenRouter service
```

## Python API

```python
from saturn import discover, select_best_service, SaturnService

# discover all services (blocking, with timeout)
services = discover(timeout=8.0, settle_time=1.0)

# select best match by capability, context size, cost
best = select_best_service(services, needs=["code"], min_context=64000, prefer_free=True)

# use the endpoint (OpenAI-compatible)
print(best.effective_endpoint)  # e.g. "http://192.168.1.10:8080"
```

## Service Configuration (TOML)

```toml
name = "my-service"
deployment = "cloud"        # cloud | local | network
api_type = "openai"         # openai | ollama | anthropic
priority = 50               # lower = preferred

[upstream]
base_url = "https://api.example.com/v1"
api_key_env = "MY_API_KEY"

[server]
port = 0                    # 0 = auto-assign

[beacon]
enabled = false
provider = "openrouter"
rotation_interval = 300
```
